title: Air, Water and Weather
parentNote: This unit covers properties of air and water, sources of water, weather, and seasons. Discuss the weather daily with your child!
learnBullets: Know the **properties of air** and why we need it
Know the **four seasons** and their features
learnItFirst:
**1. Air**

**What is air?**
- Air is all around us, but we cannot see it
- Air has no color, no smell, no taste
- Air fills up space and has weight
- Moving air is called **wind**

**Why do we need air?**
- All living things need air to **breathe**
- Plants need air (carbon dioxide) to make food
- Fire needs air to burn
- Air helps birds fly and kites soar

---

**2. Water**

**Sources of Water:**
- **Rain** — falls from clouds
- **Rivers** — flowing water
- **Lakes and Ponds** — still water
- **Wells and Tube wells** — underground water
- **Sea/Ocean** — salty water (not for drinking)

**Uses of Water:**
- Drinking, cooking, bathing
- Washing clothes and dishes
- Watering plants
- For animals to drink
- Generating electricity

**States of Water:**
- **Solid** — Ice (when water is frozen)
- **Liquid** — Water (normal form)
- **Gas** — Steam/Water vapor (when water is heated)

---

**3. Weather**

Weather tells us if the day is:
- ☀️ **Sunny** — bright, hot
- 🌧️ **Rainy** — wet, cloudy
- ☁️ **Cloudy** — sky covered with clouds
- 💨 **Windy** — lots of moving air
- ❄️ **Cold/Snowy** — very cold, may have snow

---

**4. Seasons**

| Season | Months (India) | Weather |
|--------|----------------|--------|
| **Summer** | March – June | Very hot, drink lots of water |
| **Rainy (Monsoon)** | July – September | Rain, umbrellas needed |
| **Autumn** | October – November | Cool, leaves fall |
| **Winter** | December – February | Cold, wear warm clothes |
| **Spring** | February – March | Flowers bloom, pleasant |

---

**5. Water Cycle (Simple)**

1. Sun heats water in rivers, lakes, oceans
2. Water turns into **water vapor** (evaporation)
3. Vapor goes up and forms **clouds**
4. Clouds become heavy and water falls as **rain**
5. Rain water goes back to rivers and oceans

This goes on again and again — it's called the **water cycle**!

---

questions.content: Air is ___.
questions.why: Air is invisible — we cannot see it, but it is all around us

questions.content: All living things need ___ to breathe.
questions.why: All living things need air (oxygen) to breathe and stay alive

questions.content: Moving air is called ___.
questions.why: When air moves, it is called wind

questions.content: Which of these is a source of water?
questions.why: Rivers are a natural source of water

questions.content: Rain comes from ___.
questions.why: Rain falls from clouds when they become heavy with water

questions.content: Which season is very hot?
questions.why: Summer is the hottest season — we feel very hot and sweat a lot

questions.content: In which season do we wear warm clothes?
questions.why: Winter is cold, so we wear sweaters, jackets, and warm clothes

questions.content: We use water for ___.
questions.why: We use water for drinking, bathing, cooking, and many other things

questions.content: When water freezes, it becomes ___.
questions.why: When water becomes very cold, it freezes and turns into ice

questions.content: A sunny day has lots of ___.
questions.why: On a sunny day, the sun shines brightly and there is lots of sunlight

questions.content: When water is heated, it turns into ___.
questions.why: When water is heated, it becomes steam or water vapor

questions.content: Which of these is NOT a property of air?
questions.why: Air is colorless — it is NOT blue. We see blue sky because of how light scatters

questions.content: Which of these needs air to work?
questions.why: Fire needs air (oxygen) to burn. Without air, the candle will go out

questions.content: Sea water is ___.
questions.why: Sea water is salty and not good for drinking

questions.content: In which season do we carry umbrellas?
questions.why: In the rainy season, it rains a lot, so we carry umbrellas to stay dry

questions.content: Underground water is found in ___.
questions.why: We get underground water from wells and tube wells

questions.content: In spring season, we see ___.
questions.why: Spring is when flowers bloom and the weather is pleasant

questions.content: Clouds are made of ___.
questions.why: Clouds are made of tiny water droplets floating in the sky

questions.content: What happens to leaves in autumn?
questions.why: In autumn, leaves change color and fall from many trees

questions.content: We should save water because ___.

options.B: Clean water is limited and precious

questions.why: Clean drinking water is limited. We should not waste it

questions.content: Which of these helps a kite fly?
questions.why: Wind (moving air) helps kites fly up in the sky

questions.content: Ice, water, and steam are all forms of ___.
questions.why: Ice (solid), water (liquid), and steam (gas) are all forms of water

questions.content: On a rainy day, the sky is usually ___.
questions.why: On a rainy day, clouds cover the sky and it may be dark

questions.content: Why do we feel cool when wind blows?

options.A: Wind takes away heat from our body

questions.why: Moving air (wind) takes away heat from our body and makes us feel cool

questions.content: Which of these is true about air?

options.C: Air is heavy like a rock

questions.why: Air has weight — it is light but not weightless

sections.name: Achiever's Corner
sections.leadingContext: These questions are a bit tricky. Think carefully!

questions.content: Riya put a glass upside down in water. The water did not fill the glass completely. Why?

options.B: Air inside the glass took up space

questions.why: Air inside the glass takes up space and doesn't let water enter completely

questions.content: Wet clothes dry faster on a sunny and windy day because ___.

options.D: Sun heats the water and wind carries the vapor away

questions.why: The sun heats the water in clothes (evaporation) and wind carries the water vapor away quickly

questions.content: In the water cycle, water goes from the ocean to the sky and back to the ground. What makes the water go up?

options.A: The sun heats it and it evaporates

questions.why: The sun heats water, turning it into vapor that rises up to form clouds

questions.content: If there were no air on Earth, which of these would happen?
questions.why: All living things need air to breathe. Without air, nothing can survive

questions.content: Aman lives in a place where it is cold most of the year and sometimes snow falls. He most likely lives in the ___.
questions.why: Mountains and hilly areas are cold, and it often snows there in winter
